title: Make a Reservation
ritualsDesc: Traditional Latvian sauna rituals for deep relaxation and cleansing. Our experienced sauna masters tailor each ritual to you, for body and mind.
rentDesc: Your own private sauna in the quiet of the forest. Perfect for a peaceful getaway or a memorable evening with friends and family.
transportDesc: By bus from Riga to the "Dzimtmisa" stop – we collect you there free of charge (choose it when booking). Or choose the transfer from Riga and back – €60 for up to 4 people, €120 for up to 8; for larger groups the price is agreed separately.
